description:
⭐ The cohort SCREENER: "which stocks in <a group> are interesting / winning / losing / most-talked-about,
    and how cheap or expensive do they trade?" Ranks the companies in a scope by how news is hitting them (lead with
    the winners-vs-losers split), and EVERY row carries its VALUATION (P/E, P/B, dividend yield, 52w) — so this is
    also the tool for "which in <group> are cheap / worth investing" (pulse(kind='theme')/brief are news-only, no valuation —
    pull P/E from here; P/B leads for banks/insurers).
    ⚠️ Rows are a NEWS-RANKED, CAPPED SUBSET, not the full cohort — do NOT compute a sector/peer AVERAGE from them
    (biased sample). For "cheaper/richer than the sector average / below-above the group / undervalued vs peers" use
    screen_unified with a `below_average`/`above_average` pattern (proper cap-weighted, outlier-cleaned benchmark).
    Scope ≥1 REQUIRED (never whole-universe): megatrend / gics / country — combine freely.
    Each row = {symbol, name, country, gic_code, market_cap_usd, impact:{news_count, pos, neg, ambiguous,
    net_direction, top_relevance, aspects, top_reason}, fundamentals:{pe_ratio, pb_ratio, dividend_yield_pct,
    week52_high, week52_low}}; `direction_split` pre-tallies winners/losers. ⚠️ per-stock impact scoring exists only
    from ~2026-07-03 — an earlier window returns empty (say so, not "nothing happened"). One ticker → pulse(kind='asset');
    a group's overall pulse → pulse(kind='theme'); a sector-average benchmark → screen_unified.

aspect.description: Impact CHANNEL filter (e.g. `demand`, `competition`, `tariff`, `monetary`). Omit → all channels.
aspect.title: Aspect

country.description: Market filter — CSV of ISO-2 codes (e.g. `US` or `CN,TW,HK`). 🌍 If the question names a NATIONALITY or REGION ('European','Thai','Chinese','ASEAN'), put it HERE — never leave it inside a concept/`q`/`gics` field. Enumerate a region into its member ISO-2s yourself (Europe→GB,DE,FR,IT,ES,NL,CH,SE; ASEAN→TH,SG,MY,ID,PH,VN).
country.title: Country

direction.description: `pos` → winners only · `neg` → losers/at-risk only · omit → all.
direction.title: Direction

from_.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. ⚠️ per-stock impact scoring only exists from ~2026-07-03 (earlier → empty).
from_.title: From

gate.description: megatrend scope only: `both` (default, strict member AND epicenter) | `membership` (looser).
gate.title: Gate

gics.description: A GICS sector/industry — a CODE PREFIX (sector `25` / group `2550` / industry `255010` / sub `25501010`, CSV for several) OR plain English ('banks', 'semiconductors', 'biotech'); the server resolves it. 🔴 ENGLISH (translate the concept first: ธนาคาร→'banks'). So 'European banks' = gics='banks' + country=EU codes.
gics.title: Gics

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles.
limit.title: Limit

megatrend.description: A megatrend node — a name/slug (resolved for you, e.g. `foundry`) or an int node id. CSV for several.
megatrend.title: Megatrend

window.description: News-recency window: `7d`/`30d`/`90d`/`180d`/`1y` or `mtd`/`qtd`/`ytd`. Omit → a sensible default. (Price history is unaffected — this only scopes the NEWS lens.)
window.title: Window

name: screen_stocks
title: Screen Stocks
